message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the **federal public holidays in Canada that create long‑weekends in 2023** (i.e., holidays that fall on a Friday or Monday, giving you a three‑day weekend).  Note that some provinces have extra holidays that can also create long weekends, but the list below covers the nationwide holidays that apply to all Canadians.

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend? | Typical Long‑Weekend Dates |
|---------|-------------|-------------|---------------|----------------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 | Sunday | No | – |
| Family Day (Ontario, Alberta, Saskatchewan, etc.) | Feb 20 | Monday | **Yes** | Feb 20–22 |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 | Friday | **Yes** | Apr 7–9 |
| Victoria Day | May 22 | Monday | **Yes** | May 22–24 |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 | Saturday | No | – |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 | Monday | **Yes** | Sep 4–6 |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 | Monday | **Yes** | Oct 9–11 |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 | Saturday | No | – |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 | Monday | **Yes** | Dec 25–27 |
| Boxing Day | Dec 26 | Tuesday | No | – |

### Quick Summary of Long‑Weekends (2023)

| Long‑Weekend | Dates |
|--------------|-------|
| Family Day | Feb 20–22 |
| Good Friday | Apr 7–9 |
| Victoria Day | May 22–24 |
| Labour Day | Sep 4–6 |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9–11 |
| Christmas | Dec 25–27 |

---

#### How to Pull This Data Programmatically

If you’d like to fetch this information automatically for your holiday‑planning app, you can use a public holiday API such as:

| API | Example Endpoint (Canada, 2023) |
|-----|---------------------------------|
| **Calendarific** | `https://calendarific.com/api/v2/holidays?api_key=YOUR_KEY&country=CA&year=2023` |
| **TimeandDate.com** | `https://www.timeanddate.com/holidays/canada/2023` (scrape or use their API if available) |
| **Google Calendar API** | Create a calendar for Canada’s public holidays and query events for 2023 |

These services typically return JSON with holiday names, dates, and whether they’re observed on a weekday. You can then filter for holidays that fall on a Friday or Monday to identify long weekends.

Let me know if you’d like a sample script (e.g., in JavaScript or Python) that pulls this data from one of those APIs!
